The skill "Association with survival (R1)" (r1-prognosis) was run with the GRAPHY-Next plugin research-stats t.
Input files: f.csv（139 rows、SHA-256 aaaaaaaaaaaa）; c.csv（70 rows、SHA-256 not available）.
The feature table (139 rows, 70 patients) and the clinical table (70 patients) were joined by patient ID; 70 patients were analysed. Patients only in the feature table: 0; only in the clinical table: 0.
70 patients had both time and event.
Missing values were not filled with 0 and were kept missing (the mean over several lesions ignores missing values).
For 46 patients with several rows (115 rows in total; 1 to 3 rows per patient), the rows were averaged per patient, ignoring missing values.
Leakage check: 0 ID, provenance or record columns were among the features; 0 features were suspected of containing the outcome.
70 patients (57 events) entered the survival analysis. Each feature was split by the median into two groups (three for tertiles) and compared with Kaplan–Meier curves, the log-rank test and Cox proportional hazards models (Efron's approximation for ties); the continuous Cox models used standardised values (per SD).

The apparent C-index was 0.679.

r2.en:
The skill "Discrimination of two groups (R2)" (r2-discrimination) was run with the GRAPHY-Next plugin research-stats t.
Input files: f.csv（139 rows、SHA-256 aaaaaaaaaaaa）; c.csv（70 rows、SHA-256 not available）.
The feature table (139 rows, 70 patients) and the clinical table (70 patients) were joined by patient ID; 70 patients were analysed. Patients only in the feature table: 0; only in the clinical table: 0.
70 patients had both time and event.
Missing values were not filled with 0 and were kept missing (the mean over several lesions ignores missing values).
For 46 patients with several rows (115 rows in total; 1 to 3 rows per patient), the rows were averaged per patient, ignoring missing values.
Leakage check: 0 ID, provenance or record columns were among the features; 0 features were suspected of containing the outcome.
"resp" was the positive outcome (27 patients) and "no" the negative (43). For each feature, the ROC curve and AUC (DeLong 95% CI; the direction giving AUC of at least 0.5) were computed, and sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV and accuracy at the cut-off with maximum accuracy are given with exact Clopper–Pearson 95% CIs. Values by outcome were compared with the Mann–Whitney test (normal approximation).
4 comparisons were corrected with the Benjamini–Hochberg procedure (q < 0.050).

r5.ja:
スキル「少数の特徴で予後モデル（R5）」（r5-model）を、GRAPHY-Next プラグイン research-stats t で実行した。
入力ファイル: f.csv（139 行、SHA-256 aaaaaaaaaaaa）、c.csv（70 行、SHA-256 未取得）。
特徴量の表 139 行（70 患者）と臨床の表（70 患者）を患者 ID で結合し、70 患者を解析の対象とした。特徴量の表だけにいた患者は 0、臨床の表だけにいた患者は 0。
時間とイベントが揃った患者は 70 人であった。
欠損は 0 で補わず、欠損のまま扱った（複数病変の平均は欠損を除いて求めた）。
同じ患者に複数の行がある 46 人（計 115 行、患者あたり 1〜3 行）は、欠損を除く平均で患者ごとに 1 行にまとめた。
データリークの検査: ID・由来・記録に当たる列が特徴量に 0 個、目的変数の混入の疑いがある特徴量が 0 個あった。
時間とイベントが揃った 70 人（イベント 57 件）を対象とし、欠損の無い 4 個の特徴量を用いた（欠損で除いた特徴量 0 個）。
値が 1 種類の特徴量と、|Spearman の ρ| ≥ 0.900 の組の片方（欠損の少ない方、同じなら列の順が先の方を残す）を除いた（0 個）。
候補は、成分ごとの尤度ベースの Cox ブースティング（線形の基底、100 反復、学習率 0.100、同時刻は Breslow）で係数が 0 でない特徴量とし、変数重要度（減った −対数部分尤度）の順に並べた（4 個）。このブースティングが R の mboost と同じ値になるかは確かめていない。
候補から多変量 Cox モデル（Efron の近似）による後退選択（Wald の p が 0.150 を超えたら除き、除いた変数は p < 0.100 なら戻す）を行い、4 個を超えた分は p の大きい順に除いた。選ばれた特徴量: f_a, f_b。
Harrell の C-index は見かけ 0.688。
比例ハザードの仮定は、スケールした Schoenfeld 残差と Grambsch–Therneau の検定（時間は 1 − Kaplan–Meier）で確かめた（全体 p = 0.942）。
乱数シード: 1。既定値から変更した設定: featureIdColumn=RowID、patientColumn=Patient、clinicalIdColumn=Patient、timeColumn=time、eventColumn=event、outcomeColumn=outcome、r5Corr=0.9、r5BoostNu=0.1、r5BootstrapB=0。

r5.en:
The skill "Prognostic model with few features (R5)" (r5-model) was run with the GRAPHY-Next plugin research-stats t.
Input files: f.csv（139 rows、SHA-256 aaaaaaaaaaaa）; c.csv（70 rows、SHA-256 not available）.
The feature table (139 rows, 70 patients) and the clinical table (70 patients) were joined by patient ID; 70 patients were analysed. Patients only in the feature table: 0; only in the clinical table: 0.
70 patients had both time and event.
Missing values were not filled with 0 and were kept missing (the mean over several lesions ignores missing values).
For 46 patients with several rows (115 rows in total; 1 to 3 rows per patient), the rows were averaged per patient, ignoring missing values.
Leakage check: 0 ID, provenance or record columns were among the features; 0 features were suspected of containing the outcome.
70 patients with time and event (57 events) were included, using the 4 features without missing values (0 features with missing values removed).
Features with a single value, and one of each pair with |Spearman's rho| >= 0.900 (keeping the one with fewer missing values, then the earlier column), were removed (0).
Candidates were the features with non-zero coefficients in component-wise likelihood-based Cox boosting (linear base learners, 100 iterations, learning rate 0.100, Breslow ties), ordered by variable importance (reduction in -log partial likelihood) (4). Whether this boosting gives the same values as R's mboost has not been checked.
Backward selection with multivariable Cox models (Efron) removed variables with Wald p > 0.150 and re-entered removed ones with p < 0.100; beyond 4 variables, those with the largest p were removed. Selected features: f_a, f_b.
Harrell's C-index was 0.688 (apparent).
Proportional hazards were checked with scaled Schoenfeld residuals and the Grambsch-Therneau test (time transformed by 1 - Kaplan-Meier; global p = 0.942).
Random seed: 1. Settings changed from the defaults: featureIdColumn=RowID; patientColumn=Patient; clinicalIdColumn=Patient; timeColumn=time; eventColumn=event; outcomeColumn=outcome; r5Corr=0.9; r5BoostNu=0.1; r5BootstrapB=0.
For research use only; not for diagnostic or treatment decisions.

p4-topk-none.ja:
スキル「予測モデルの性能（入れ子の交差検証とテスト集合）」（p4-pipeline）を、GRAPHY-Next プラグイン research-stats t で実行した。
入力ファイル: f.csv（139 行、SHA-256 aaaaaaaaaaaa）、c.csv（70 行、SHA-256 未取得）。
特徴量の表 139 行（70 患者）と臨床の表（70 患者）を患者 ID で結合し、70 患者を解析の対象とした。特徴量の表だけにいた患者は 0、臨床の表だけにいた患者は 0。
時間とイベントが揃った患者は 70 人であった。
欠損は 0 で補わず、欠損のまま扱った（複数病変の平均は欠損を除いて求めた）。
同じ患者に複数の行がある 46 人（計 115 行、患者あたり 1〜3 行）は、欠損を除く平均で患者ごとに 1 行にまとめた。
データリークの検査: ID・由来・記録に当たる列が特徴量に 0 個、目的変数の混入の疑いがある特徴量が 0 個あった。
分割の検査（同じ患者が訓練と検証に分かれていないか）: OK。前処理・特徴量選択の推定に使った行の検査（訓練側の行だけか）: OK（impute@inner:0/12 rank@inner:0/12 fit@inner:0/24 impute@fold:0/4 rank@fold:0/4 fit@fold:0/4 impute@finalInner:0/3 rank@finalInner:0/3 fit@finalInner:0/6 impute@final:0/1 rank@final:0/1 fit@final:0/1）。
結果ラベル「resp」を陽性とし、70 人（陽性 27 人）を対象とした。
テスト集合は設けず、交差検証による推定だけを示す。
4 個の特徴量を用いた（開発集合の症例数 / 特徴量の数 = 17.500）。
性能は、外側 4 分割（層化）× 1 回、内側 3 分割（層化しない）の入れ子の交差検証で見積もった。各訓練分割の中だけで、特徴量の順位付け（Mann–Whitney 検定の p の小さい順）、標準化、ロジスティック回帰（罰則なし）の当てはめを行い、使う特徴量の数を候補 {1, 2} から内側の交差検証（予測を束ねた AUC が最大、同じなら少ない方）で選んだ。
外側の分割ごとの AUC は平均 0.870（最小 0.712・最大 1、評価できた分割 4/4）、予測を束ねた AUC は 0.848（反復の平均）であった。交差検証の推定値には信頼区間は付けない（分割の間の相関のため、素朴な区間は狭すぎる）。
最終モデルは、開発集合全体での交差検証で特徴量の数を選び（2 個）、開発集合全体で作り直した（f_a + f_b）。入れ子の交差検証の値は、この手順全体の性能の見積もりである。
乱数シード: 1。既定値から変更した設定: featureIdColumn=RowID、patientColumn=Patient、clinicalIdColumn=Patient、timeColumn=time、eventColumn=event、outcomeColumn=outcome、outcomeKind=binary、positiveLabel=resp、lockMode=none、outerK=4、innerK=3、repeats=1、kCandidates=1, 2。

p4-topk-none.en:
The skill "Prediction model performance (nested cross-validation and test set)" (p4-pipeline) was run with the GRAPHY-Next plugin research-stats t.
Input files: f.csv（139 rows、SHA-256 aaaaaaaaaaaa）; c.csv（70 rows、SHA-256 not available）.
The feature table (139 rows, 70 patients) and the clinical table (70 patients) were joined by patient ID; 70 patients were analysed. Patients only in the feature table: 0; only in the clinical table: 0.
70 patients had both time and event.
Missing values were not filled with 0 and were kept missing (the mean over several lesions ignores missing values).
For 46 patients with several rows (115 rows in total; 1 to 3 rows per patient), the rows were averaged per patient, ignoring missing values.
Leakage check: 0 ID, provenance or record columns were among the features; 0 features were suspected of containing the outcome.
Split check (no patient in both training and validation): OK. Row-use check (preprocessing and selection estimated from training rows only): OK (impute@inner:0/12 rank@inner:0/12 fit@inner:0/24 impute@fold:0/4 rank@fold:0/4 fit@fold:0/4 impute@finalInner:0/3 rank@finalInner:0/3 fit@finalInner:0/6 impute@final:0/1 rank@final:0/1 fit@final:0/1).
"resp" was the positive outcome; 70 patients (27 positive) were included.
No test set was held out; only cross-validated estimates are reported.
4 features were used (development cases / features = 17.500).
Performance was estimated by nested cross-validation with 4 outer folds (stratified) x 1 repeat(s) and 3 inner folds (not stratified). Within each training split only, features were ranked (Mann-Whitney p value), standardised and combined by logistic regression (no penalty); the number of features was chosen from {1, 2} by the inner cross-validation (highest pooled AUC, ties to the smaller number).
The outer-fold AUC was 0.870 on average (min 0.712, max 1; 4/4 folds evaluable); the pooled AUC was 0.848 (mean over repeats). No confidence interval is given for the cross-validated estimate (naive intervals are too narrow because the folds are correlated).
The final model chose the number of features by cross-validation on the whole development set (2) and was refitted on it (f_a + f_b). The nested cross-validation estimates the performance of this whole procedure.
Random seed: 1. Settings changed from the defaults: featureIdColumn=RowID; patientColumn=Patient; clinicalIdColumn=Patient; timeColumn=time; eventColumn=event; outcomeColumn=outcome; outcomeKind=binary; positiveLabel=resp; lockMode=none; outerK=4; innerK=3; repeats=1; kCandidates=1, 2.
For research use only; not for diagnostic or treatment decisions.
